deterministic HTTP API for D&D 5e style helpers. It runs on OpenJDK\nwith only the Java standard library and shells out to a local `sqlite3` binary\nfor persistence.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles the Java sources under `dnd/` and runs `dnd.Main` in the\nforeground. The server listens on `127.0.0.1` and honors the `PORT` environment\nvariable (default `8080`).\n\nVerify it is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# -> {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and major files\n\n```\ndnd/\n  Main.java                 # entry point: opens the HTTP socket and wires the router\n  handlers/\n    RequestRouter.java      # registers top-level HTTP contexts; sub-routes are parsed in domain handlers\n    BaseHandler.java        # shared response helpers, exact error JSON constants, Bearer auth\n    CoreHandler.java        # health, dice stats, checks, encounter math, initiative, character rules\n    CombatHandler.java      # persisted combat sessions\n    AuthHandler.java        # user registration and login (PBKDF2 hashing)\n    StorageHandler.java     # storage status and reset\n    CompendiumHandler.java  # monster and item compendium entries\n    CampaignHandler.java    # campaign state, quests, factions, NPCs, inventory, equipment,\n                            # crafting, sessions, analytics, and export\n    PhbHandler.java         # Player's Handbook helpers: spell slots, rests, equipment load\n    DmToolHandler.java      # DM helpers: encounter builder, loot parcel, session recap\n    PlayCampaignHandler.java # play-surface campaigns: membership, turn queue, narration,\n                             # actions/resolutions, nudges, documents, locations/travel/scenes,\n                             # encounters, rewards, character ownership/build/level/skill checks\n  server/\n    HttpSupport.java        # read request bodies, send JSON responses\n  game/\n    Rules.java              # dice, XP, encounter difficulty, ability modifiers,\n                            # valid race/class/background/skill lists, open-thread derivation\n  json/\n    JsonParser.java         # minimal recursive-descent JSON parser\n    JsonUtils.java          # JSON serialization and int coercion\n  model/\n    Combatant.java          # initiative combatant\n    CombatSession.java      # persisted encounter\n    Condition.java          # status condition on a combatant\n    User.java               # registered user with salt/hash\n  storage/\n    Storage.java            # SQLite-backed persistence layer\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles everything with `javac -d .` and then runs `java dnd.Main`.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db`, a SQLite database. `Storage` shells out\nto the `sqlite3` binary for each query and wraps every public method with a\nsingle `synchronized` lock, because each query is an independent process.\nThe schema is created lazily by `Storage.init()` and recreated by\n`Storage.reset()`.\n\n`Main` calls `storage.reset()` on startup so every benchmark run begins from a\ndeterministic, empty database. Do not rely on data surviving a server restart.\nA JVM shutdown hook stops the `HttpServer` on SIGTERM/SIGINT so the process\nexits cleanly when the harness or user terminates it.\n\nCommon persistence helpers live in `Storage` as private methods:\n\n- `executeInsert(...)` runs a write transaction and maps `UNIQUE` constraint\n  failures to `false` so callers can return `409`.\n- `queryCount(...)` simplifies `SELECT COUNT(*) AS c` reads.\n- `quote(...)` escapes single quotes for SQLite string literals.\n- `addColumnIfMissing(...)` runs `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` and ignores\n  SQLite \"duplicate column name\" errors so the schema can evolve safely.\n\nTables:\n\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2 hash and salt.\n- `combat_sessions`, `combatants`, `conditions` — initiative and condition tracking.\n- `monsters`, `monster_tags` — monster compendium.\n- `items` — item compendium.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events`, `quests`,\n  `quest_milestones` — campaign state, session log, and quest tracker.\n- `factions`, `npcs` — campaign factions and NPCs with relationship disposition.\n- `sessions`, `session_attendance` — scheduled campaign sessions and per-character attendance.\n- `play_campaigns` — protected play-surface campaigns owned by a `dm` user.\n- `play_campaign_members` — player memberships in a play campaign, one row per\n  `(campaign_id, username)` and unique `character_id` per campaign.\n- `play_campaign_narrations` — append-only campaign log: narration, action,\n  resolution, nudge, scene, travel, rest, and combat_action events.\n- `play_campaign_scenes` — scene definitions and open/closed status.\n- `play_campaign_locations`, `play_campaign_location_connections` — location\n  graph and travel-turn cost edges.\n- `play_campaign_encounters`, `play_campaign_encounter_monsters`,\n  `play_campaign_encounter_combatants`, `play_campaign_encounter_conditions`,\n  `play_campaign_encounter_readies`, `play_campaign_encounter_loot` — campaign\n  encounters, turn order, HP, conditions, ready actions, and rewards.\n\n### Routing\n\n`Main` creates an `HttpServer` from `com.sun.net.httpserver`, builds a\n`RequestRouter`, and calls `router.register(server)` to attach contexts.\n`RequestRouter` registers only top-level paths; each domain handler parses\nthe remainder of the path to route sub-requests. Shared concerns\n(authentication, exact error bodies, method checks) live in `BaseHandler`.\n\nShared handler infrastructure lives in `BaseHandler`:\n\n- `requireMethod`, `badRequest`, `notFound`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`\n- exact JSON error-body constants\n- `authenticate` — validates `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>` and\n  supports deterministic fixture tokens (`session-dm`, `session-player-a`,\n  `session-player-b`, `session-stranger`) even after a storage reset.\n\nMost handlers validate the request body, throw `RuntimeException` on bad input,\nand translate any exception into a `400` response. Missing resources return\n`404`. Conflicts return `409`.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\n### Core\n\n- `GET /health` — returns `{\"ok\":true}`.\n- `POST /v1/dice/stats` — parses an expression like `3d6+2` and returns dice\n  count, sides, modifier, min, max, and average.\n- `POST /v1/checks/ability` — returns total, success/margin against a DC.\n- `POST /v1/encounters/adjusted-xp` — calculates base XP, multiplier,\n  adjusted XP, difficulty, and party thresholds.\n- `POST /v1/initiative/order` — sorts combatants by `roll + dex`, breaking ties\n  by dex then name.\n- `POST /v1/characters/ability-modifier` — returns the ability modifier for a score.\n- `POST /v1/characters/proficiency` — returns the proficiency bonus for a level.\n- `POST /v1/characters/derived-stats` — returns level, proficiency bonus,\n  `hp_max`, `armor_class`, and ability modifiers for a class/abilities/armor build.\n\n### Combat sessions\n\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions` — creates a persisted combat session with a sorted\n  order and returns the first active combatant.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/conditions` — adds a timed condition to a\n  combatant in the session.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance` — advances the round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = \" + quote(id) + \";\");\n            if (sessionRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n            Map<String, Object> sessionRow = sessionRows.get(0);\n\n            List<Combatant> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatantRows = query(\"SELECT name, score, dex, roll FROM combatants WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY sort_order;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : combatantRows) {\n                combatants.add(new Combatant((String) row.get(\"name\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"score\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"dex\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"roll\"))));\n            }\n\n            CombatSession session = new CombatSession((String) sessionRow.get(\"id\"), combatants);\n            session.round = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"round\"));\n            session.turnIndex = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"turn_index\"));\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> conditionRows = query(\"SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM conditions WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY id;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : conditionRows) {\n                String target = (String) row.get(\"target\");\n                session.conditions.computeIfAbsent(target, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(new Condition((String) row.get(\"condition\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"remaining_rounds\"))));\n            }\n\n            return session;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void addCondition(String sessionId, String target, String condition, int Object>> rows = query(\"SELECT rewards_awarded FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \";\");\n            if (rows.isEmpty()) return false;\n            if (JsonUtils.toInt(rows.get(0).get(\"rewards_awarded\")) != 0) return false;\n            Map<String, Integer> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (Map<String, Object> item : loot) {\n                String slug = (String) item.get(\"slug\");\n                int quantity = JsonUtils.toInt(item.get(\"quantity\"));\n                if (slug == null || slug.isEmpty() || quantity <= 0) return false;\n                merged.merge(slug, quantity, Integer::sum);\n            }\n            List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET xp_awarded = \" + xp + \", rewards_awarded = 1 WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \";\");\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : merged.entrySet()) {\n                String slug = entry.getKey();\n                int quantity = entry.getValue();\n                sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO play_campaign_encounter_loot (campaign_id, encounter_id, item_slug, quantity) VALUES (\" + quote(campaignId) + \", \" + quote(encounterId) + \", \" + quote(slug) + \", \" + quantity + \") ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, encounter_id, item_slug) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity;\");\n                sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (\" + quote(campaignId) + \", \" + quote(slug) + \", 'party', \" + quantity + \") ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, item_slug, owner) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity;\");\n            }\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n            return true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Map<String, Object> getEncounterRewards(String campaignId, String encounterId) {\n        synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> rows = query(\"SELECT xp_awarded Map<String, Object> endPlayCampaignEncounter(String campaignId, String encounterId) {\n        synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> encRows = query(\"SELECT status FROM campaignRows.get(0).get(\"pre_combat_actor\");\n            boolean encounterActive = \"active\".equals(encRows.get(0).get(\"status\"));\n            boolean inCombat = encounterActive || quote(restoredActor)) + \", pre_combat_actor = NULL WHERE id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n\n int currentIndex, int newIndex) {\n        synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatants = listPlayCampaignEncounterCombatants(campaignId, encounterId);\n            int size = combatants.size();\n            if (currentIndex < 0 || currentIndex >= size || newIndex <= currentIndex || newIndex >= size) return;\n            List<Map<String, Object>> reordered = new            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            for (int i = 0; i < reordered.size(); i++) {\n                String id = (String) reordered.get(i).get(\"id\");\n                String kind = (String) sort_order = \" + sortOrder + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \" AND monster_id = \" + quote(id) + \";\");\n                } else {\n                    sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_encounter_combatants SET sort_order = \" + sortOrder + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + campaignId, String encounterId, String target, int amount) {\n        synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> rows = query(\"SELECT hp_current, hp_max FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \" AND monster_id = \" + quote(target) + \";\");\n            if (!rows.isEmpty()) {\n                int hpBefore = JsonUtils.toInt(rows.get(0).get(\"hp_current\"));\n                int hpAfter = Math.max(0, hpBefore - amount);\n                execSql(\"UPDATE play_campaign_encounter_monsters SET hp_current = \" + hpAfter + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \" AND monster_id = \" + quote(target) + \";\");\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"target\", target);\n                res.put(\"hp_before\", hpBefore);\n                res.put(\"hp_after\", hpAfter);\n                res.put(\"damage\", amount);\n                return res;\n            }\n            rows = query(\"SELECT m.hp_current, m.hp_max, m.status FROM play_campaign_members m JOIN play_campaign_encounter_combatants c ON m.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND m.username = c.member WHERE c.campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND c.encounter_id = \" + quote(encounterId) + \" AND c.member = \" + quote(target) + \";\");\n            if (!rows.isEmpty()) {\n                int hpBefore = JsonUtils.toInt(rows.get(0).get(\"hp_current\"));\n                int hpMax = JsonUtils.toInt(rows.get(0).get(\"hp_max\"));\n                String status = (String) rows.get(0).get(\"status\");\n                int hpAfter = Math.max(0, hpBefore - amount);\n                       newStatus = \"unconscious\";\n                    } else {\n                        newStatus = \"conscious\";\n                        successes = 0;\n                        failures = 0;\n                    }\n                }\n                execSql(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = \" + hpAfter + \", status = \" + quote(newStatus) + \", Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"target\", target);\n                res.put(\"hp_before\", hpBefore);\n                res.put(\"hp_after\", hpAfter);\n                res.put(\"damage\", amount);\n                return res;\n            }\n            return null;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Map<String, Object> applyHealToEncounterTarget(String       synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> fromRows = query(\"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \";\");\n            if (fromRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n            List<Map<String, Object>> toRows = query(\"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \";\");\n            if (toRows.isEmpty()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Destination character not found\");\n\n            int fromGold = JsonUtils.toInt(fromRows.get(0).get(\"gold\"));\n            int toGold = JsonUtils.toInt(toRows.get(0).get(\"gold\"));\n            if (fromGold < gold) return null;\n\n            int fromGoldAfter = fromGold - gold;\n            int toGoldAfter = toGold + gold;\n            int transferId = queryCount(\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(transfer_id), 0) AS c FROM play_campaign_transfers WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \";\") + 1;\n\n            List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = \" + fromGoldAfter + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = \" + toGoldAfter + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO play_campaign_transfers (campaign_id, transfer_id, from_character_id, to_character_id, gold) VALUES (\" + quote(campaignId) + \", \" + transferId + \", \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \", \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \", \" + gold + \");\");\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"from_character_id\", fromCharacterId);\n            res.put(\"to_character_id\", toCharacterId);\n            res.put(\"gold\", gold);\n            res.put(\"from_gold\", fromGoldAfter);\n            res.put(\"to_gold\", toGoldAfter);\n            res.put(\"transfer_id\", transferId);\n            return res;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public boolean insertPlayCampaignLoot(String       synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> fromRows = query(\"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \";\");\n            if (fromRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n            List<Map<String, Object>> toRows = query(\"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \";\");\n            if (toRows.isEmpty()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Destination character not found\");\n\n            int fromGold = JsonUtils.toInt(fromRows.get(0).get(\"gold\"));\n            int toGold = JsonUtils.toInt(toRows.get(0).get(\"gold\"));\n            if (fromGold < gold) return null;\n\n            int fromGoldAfter = fromGold - gold;\n            int toGoldAfter = toGold + gold;\n            int transferId = queryCount(\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(transfer_id), 0) AS c FROM play_campaign_transfers WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \";\") + 1;\n\n            List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = \" + fromGoldAfter + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = \" + toGoldAfter + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO play_campaign_transfers (campaign_id, transfer_id, from_character_id, to_character_id, gold) VALUES (\" + quote(campaignId) + \", \" + transferId + \", \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \", \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \", \" + gold + \");\");\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"from_character_id\", fromCharacterId);\n            res.put(\"to_character_id\", toCharacterId);\n            res.put(\"gold\", gold);\n            res.put(\"from_gold\", fromGoldAfter);\n            res.put(\"to_gold\", toGoldAfter);\n            res.put(\"transfer_id\", transferId);\n            return res;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public boolean insertPlayCampaignLoot(String String characterId, String itemId, int quantity) {\n        synchronized (lock) {\n            Map<String, Object> shop = getPlayCampaignShop(campaignId, settlementId, shopId);\n            if (shop == null) return null;\n            Integer gold = getPlayCampaignCharacterGold(campaignId, characterId);\n            if (gold == null) return null;\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> stock = (Map<String, Object>) shop.get(\"stock\");\n            int currentStock = stock.containsKey(itemId) ? JsonUtils.toInt(stock.get(itemId)) : 0;\n            if (currentStock < quantity) {\n                Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                err.put(\"error\", \"insufficient_stock\");\n                return err;\n            }\n            int buyPrice = JsonUtils.toInt(shop.get(\"buy_price\"));\n            int cost = buyPrice * quantity;\n            if (gold < cost) {\n                Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                err.put(\"error\", \"insufficient_funds\");\n                return err;\n            }\n            int newStock = currentStock - quantity;\n            Map<String, Object> newStockMap = new LinkedHashMap<>(stock);\n            if (newStock > 0) {\n                newStockMap.put(itemId, newStock);\n            } else {\n                newStockMap.remove(itemId);\n            }\n            String newStockJson = JsonUtils.toJson(newStockMap);\n            int newGold = gold - cost;\n            int currentInv = getPlayCampaignCharacterInventoryQuantity(campaignId, characterId, itemId);\n            int newInv = currentInv + quantity;\n            List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_shops SET stock = \" + quote(newStockJson) + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND settlement_id = \" + quote(settlementId) + \" AND shop_id = \" + quote(shopId) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = \" + newGold + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(characterId) + \";\");\n            if (currentInv == 0) {\n                sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO play_campaign_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (\" + quote(campaignId) + \", \" + quote(characterId) + \", \" + quote(itemId) + \", \" + newInv + \");\");\n            } else {\n                sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_character_inventory SET quantity = \" + newInv + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(characterId) + \" AND item_id = \" + quote(itemId) + \";\");\n            }\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"character_id\", characterId);\n            res.put(\"item_id\", itemId);\n            res.put(\"quantity\", quantity);\n            res.put(\"gold\", newGold);\n            res.put(\"stock\", Math.max(newStock, 0));\n            return res;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Map<String, Object> sellToPlayCampaignShop(String campaignId, String settlementId, String shopId, quantity;\n            int newGold = gold + goldGain;\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> stock = (Map<String, Object>) shop.get(\"stock\");\n            int currentStock = stock.containsKey(itemId) ? recipe = getPlayCampaignRecipe(campaignId, recipeId);\n            if (recipe == null) return null;\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> ingredients = (Map<String, Object>) recipe.get(\"ingredients\");\n            String outputItem = (String) recipe.get(\"output_item\");\n            int outputQuantity = JsonUtils.toInt(recipe.get(\"output_quantity\"));\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> charRows = query(\"SELECT owner FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(characterId) + \";\");\n            if (charRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : ingredients.entrySet()) {\n                String itemId = entry.getKey();\n                int required = JsonUtils.toInt(entry.getValue());\n                int have = getPlayCampaignCharacterInventoryQuantity(campaignId, characterId, itemId);\n                if (have < required) {\n                    Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    err.put(\"error\", \"insufficient_ingredients\");\n                    return err;\n                }\n            }\n\n            Map<String, Integer> deltas = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : ingredients.entrySet()) {\n                String itemId = entry.getKey();\n                int required = JsonUtils.toInt(entry.getValue());\n                deltas.put(itemId, deltas.getOrDefault(itemId, 0) - required);\n            }\n            deltas.put(outputItem, deltas.getOrDefault(outputItem, 0) + outputQuantity);\n\n            List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : deltas.entrySet()) {\n                String itemId = entry.getKey();\n                int delta = entry.getValue();\n                int current = getPlayCampaignCharacterInventoryQuantity(campaignId, characterId, itemId);\n                int finalQuantity = current + delta;\n                if (finalQuantity < 0) {\n                    Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    err.put(\"error\", \"insufficient_ingredients\");\n                    return err;\n                }\n                if (finalQuantity == 0 && current > 0) {\n                    sqls.add(\"DELETE FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(characterId) + \" AND item_id = \" + quote(itemId) + \";\");\n                } else if (current == 0 && finalQuantity > 0) {\n                    sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO play_campaign_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (\" + quote(campaignId) + \", \" + quote(characterId) + \", \" + quote(itemId) + \", \" + finalQuantity + \");\");\n                } else if (current != finalQuantity) {\n                    sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_character_inventory SET quantity = \" + finalQuantity + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(characterId) + \" AND item_id = \" + quote(itemId) + \";\");\n                }\n            }\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"character_id\", characterId);\n            res.put(\"recipe_id\", recipeId);\n            res.put(\"output_item\", outputItem);\n            res.put(\"output_quantity\", outputQuantity);\n            return res;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public boolean        Map<String, Object> stock = (Map<String, Object>) shop.get(\"stock\");\n            int currentStock = stock.containsKey(itemId) ? JsonUtils.toInt(stock.get(itemId)) : 0;\n            if (currentStock < quantity) {\n                Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                err.put(\"error\", \"insufficient_stock\");\n                return err;\n            }\n            int buyPrice = JsonUtils.toInt(shop.get(\"buy_price\"));\n            int cost = buyPrice * quantity;\n            if (gold < cost) {\n                Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                err.put(\"error\", \"insufficient_funds\");\n                return err;\n            }\n            int newStock = currentStock - quantity;\n            Map<String, Object> newStockMap = new LinkedHashMap<>(stock);\n            if (newStock > 0) {\n                newStockMap.put(itemId, newStock);\n            } else {\n                newStockMap.remove(itemId);\n            }\n            String newStockJson = JsonUtils.toJson(newStockMap);\n            int newGold = gold - cost;\n            int currentInv = getPlayCampaignCharacterInventoryQuantity(campaignId, characterId, itemId);\n            int newInv = currentInv + quantity;\n            List<String> sqls = new sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_character_inventory SET quantity = \" + newInv + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(characterId) + \" AND item_id = \" + quote(itemId) + \";\");\n            }\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"character_id\", characterId);\n            res.put(\"item_id\", itemId);\n            res.put(\"quantity\", quantity);\n            res.put(\"gold\", newGold);\n            res.put(\"stock\", Math.max(newStock, 0));\n            return res;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Map<String, Object> sellToPlayCampaignShop(String campaignId, String settlementId, String shopId, recipe = getPlayCampaignRecipe(campaignId, recipeId);\n            if (recipe == null) return null;\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> ingredients = (Map<String, Object>) recipe.get(\"ingredients\");\n            String outputItem = (String) recipe.get(\"output_item\");\n            int outputQuantity = JsonUtils.toInt(recipe.get(\"output_quantity\"));\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> charRows = query(\"SELECT owner FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(characterId) + \";\");\n            if (charRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : ingredients.entrySet()) {\n                String itemId = entry.getKey();\n                int required = JsonUtils.toInt(entry.getValue());\n                int have = getPlayCampaignCharacterInventoryQuantity(campaignId, characterId, itemId);\n                if (have < required) {\n                    Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    err.put(\"error\", \"insufficient_ingredients\");\n                    return err;\n                }\n            }\n\n            Map<String, Integer> deltas = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : ingredients.entrySet()) {\n                String itemId = entry.getKey();\n                int required = JsonUtils.toInt(entry.getValue());\n                deltas.put(itemId, deltas.getOrDefault(itemId, 0) - required);\n            }\n            deltas.put(outputItem, deltas.getOrDefault(outputItem, 0) + outputQuantity);\n\n            List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : deltas.entrySet()) {\n                String itemId = entry.getKey();\n                int delta = entry.getValue();\n                int current = getPlayCampaignCharacterInventoryQuantity(campaignId, characterId, itemId);\n                int finalQuantity = current + delta;\n                if (finalQuantity < 0) {\n                    Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    err.put(\"error\", \"insufficient_ingredients\");\n                    return err;\n                }\n                if (finalQuantity == 0 && current > 0) {\n                    sqls.add(\"DELETE FROM play_campaign_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(characterId) + \" AND item_id = \" + quote(itemId) + \";\");\n                } else if (current == 0 && finalQuantity > 0) {\n                    sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO play_campaign_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (\" + quote(campaignId) + \", \" + quote(characterId) + \", \" + quote(itemId) + \", \" + finalQuantity + \");\");\n                } else if (current != finalQuantity) {\n                    sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_character_inventory SET quantity = \" + finalQuantity + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(characterId) + \" AND item_id = \" + quote(itemId) + \";\");\n                }\n            }\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"character_id\", characterId);\n            res.put(\"recipe_id\", recipeId);\n            res.put(\"output_item\", outputItem);\n            res.put(\"output_quantity\", outputQuantity);\n            return res;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public boolean
